title: Brain Stroke Detection Using AI
description: In the Healthcare project, two machine learning algorithms (ANN and SVM) were employed to classify brain MRI scans as Ischemic or Hemorrhage stroke, utilizing features extracted from the images through the Grey-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) texture analysis method and TensorFlow for monitoring.
